title: chore(storybook): update to Storybook 5
body:
This upgrades to Storybook 5 ([see migration notes](https://github.com/storybooks/storybook/blob/next/MIGRATION.md#from-version-41x-to-50x)).

Since the [URL structure changed](https://github.com/storybooks/storybook/blob/next/MIGRATION.md#new-url-structure), we need to update the documentation story links when merging this PR.

[See stories →](https://deploy-preview-3585--instantsearchjs.netlify.com/stories)

comments.body:
Deploy preview for *instantsearchjs* ready!

Built with commit 75a573ea4ba011f2dbeff782bcbc6178a46d8502

https://deploy-preview-3585--instantsearchjs.netlify.com
The search doesn't seem be working for me 🤔 getting these errors

You can add redirections of a query string with Netlify, but as said, I'm not sure if it's worth it, we can just update the URLs in the docs. 

This is definitely a nice improvement!
Can the logo be changed to "InstantSearch.js" again with v5?

> The search doesn't seem be working for me 🤔

Indeed, it works in watch mode though.
 
> You can add redirections of a query string with Netlify, but as said, I'm not sure if it's worth it, we can just update the URLs in the docs.

The previous links will keep working for a while because Storybook keeps backward compatibility. Still, we should update them in the doc.

> Can the logo be changed to "InstantSearch.js" again with v5?

Yes – which logo do you have in mind?

> Can the logo be changed to "InstantSearch.js" again with v5?

Either the text, or we can ask for / make  a horizontal version of the InstantSearch logo with the text next to it

The search in production bug will be solved by upgrading to Storybook 5.0.1 ([see issue](https://github.com/storybooks/storybook/pull/5909)). I'll update the PR.

Regarding the logo, it could be cool to ask the design team. Right now we don't have a logo with text AFAIK.
